detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared Unity gate in ForkHorizon/ci-gates: compiles Assembly-CSharp with Microsoft.Unity.Analyzers and fails on analyzer or compiler warnings in first-party code, plus jscpd copy-paste detection for C#. Uses a persistent per-repo workspace cache on the runner, so the first run clones and imports the project once and later runs take seconds.

files.contents:
name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: unity-quality-gate-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  unity-quality-gate:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/unity-quality.yml@main
    with:
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'
      duplication-threshold: "{{duplication_threshold}}"

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`
- `.{{script_slug}}.json`

The workflow calls the shared gate in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`. It compiles the Unity project with Microsoft.Unity.Analyzers and blocks analyzer/compiler warnings in first-party code (Assets/ minus Plugins, Libs, TextMesh Pro), plus copy-paste detection. The first CI run primes a persistent workspace cache on the runner and can take several minutes; later runs are incremental.
summary: Compiles Unity C# with analyzers and blocks warnings and copy-paste in first-party code.
title: Unity Quality Gate

variables.help: Max allowed duplicated-code percentage before the gate fails.
variables.title: Duplication threshold %
